title: Helium Seems Common, But Its Price Once Jumped 4x
hook: A helium supply crunch once drove prices up 4x.
closing: Limited supply and rising demand can make an everyday gas suddenly expensive.
question: Would helium prices change balloon traditions?

segments.say: Qatar holds 10.1 billion cubic meters of helium reserves, concentrating a major share of supply in one country.
Projected helium demand reaches an index of 190. More buyers will chase a limited supply.
Helium's price index reached 400 during a supply crunch. Tight supply can make prices jump fast.
